appDescription: A driving logbook for sales staff that records business trips and the client visits made at each stop.

function.name: RECORD_CLIENT_VISIT
function.description: Save a sales visit note for the trip the user is driving or has just finished, so it appears in the visit log.

summary.description: Short summary of what happened at the visit, in the user's language, at most 20 characters.

client.description: Name of the client company that was visited.

contact.description: Name and job title of the person the user met at the client.

followUp.description: The next task the user promised to do for this client.

followUpWhen.description: When the follow-up task is due, copied exactly in the user's own words without converting it to a date.
